steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: walk-overlay-auto-hides
steps.failMessage: overlay did not auto-hide (loading.active stayed true). This scenario tests the hide LOGIC, so the store flag is the right assertion — NOT the element unmounting, which v0.31.8.93 found can lag indefinitely (see TODO.md: the overlay stays mounted at opacity 0), and NOT the label text, which `visible: false` cannot judge. The `-appears-first` step above is what stops this passing vacuously.
